items.problem: The article fills all 26 slots by the middle of "Evaluation"; about 53,000 characters, including Limitations and challenges, Safety and Societal concerns (copyright, energy demands), are never stored.
items.fix: For a page this long the fix is structural: move the detail of the long middle sections into their "Main article" pages and keep a two-paragraph summary here, so the later sections fall inside the cap.

items.problem: Every section's text carries the "[ edit ]" link labels; they cost characters in every passage and make "edit" one of the page's top keywords.
items.fix: Keep edit links out of the readable text (render them as icons with an aria-label, or outside the heading's text node), so the passage starts with the heading's subject.

items.after: Scaling laws. Main article: Neural scaling law

items.problem: Formulas are extracted twice, as the rendered symbols and as their LaTeX source ("{\displaystyle C}"), so the passages on scaling and perplexity read as noise.
items.fix: Expose one text form of each formula (the alt text or the MathML, not both), and state the formula's meaning in a sentence next to it.

items.fix: Promote the long sections' subsections to h2, or open each subsection with a sentence that names its subject, so a retriever never receives a passage that starts with a verb.
